verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a real v2 REST API with tokens, versioning, pagination, and search/filter (rippling-it-docs-14,15,16,17,21), showing broad API access, but there is no evidence claiming or demonstrating full functional parity between the API and every UI-driven workflow (e.g., device lifecycle automations, compliance evidence collection, dynamic access rules). Missing for 10: explicit parity claims/documentation, coverage of admin/config workflows via API, and independent verification that all UI actions are API-exposed.
